travel_data_access_values_check.name: travel_data_access_values_check
travel_data_access_values_check.value:
("travel_data_access"."action" = 'view' and "travel_data_access"."field" is null)
        or ("travel_data_access"."action" = 'copy' and "travel_data_access"."field" in ('given_name', 'family_name', 'birth_date', 'sex', 'nationality', 'document_type', 'document_number', 'document_expiry', 'issuing_country'))

travel_data_release_values_check.name: travel_data_release_values_check
travel_data_release_values_check.value:
octet_length("travel_data_release"."nonce") = 12 and octet_length("travel_data_release"."ciphertext") between 17 and 8192
        and "travel_data_release"."key_id" ~ '^[a-z0-9-]{1,16}$' and "travel_data_release"."consent_locale" in ('de', 'en')

travel_data_request_fields_check.name: travel_data_request_fields_check
travel_data_request_fields_check.value:
"travel_data_request"."fields" <@ array['legal_name', 'birth_date', 'sex', 'nationality', 'document', 'document_expiry', 'issuing_country']::text[]
        and 'legal_name' = any("travel_data_request"."fields")
        and (not ('document_expiry' = any("travel_data_request"."fields") or 'issuing_country' = any("travel_data_request"."fields")) or 'document' = any("travel_data_request"."fields"))

travel_data_request_closed_check.name: travel_data_request_closed_check
travel_data_request_closed_check.value:
("travel_data_request"."closed_at" is null) = ("travel_data_request"."closed_reason" is null)
        and ("travel_data_request"."closed_reason" is null or "travel_data_request"."closed_reason" in ('done', 'booker_revoked', 'requester_left', 'expired', 'unfixed'))

trip_fixed_check.name: trip_fixed_check
trip_fixed_check.value: ("trip"."phase" = 'fixed') = ("trip"."fixed_start" is not null and "trip"."fixed_end" is not null)

trip_cost_party_kind_check.name: trip_cost_party_kind_check
trip_cost_party_kind_check.value: not ("trip_cost_party"."user_id" is not null and "trip_cost_party"."placeholder_id" is not null)

trip_expense_values_check.name: trip_expense_values_check
trip_expense_values_check.value:
char_length("trip_expense"."title") between 1 and 60
        and coalesce(char_length("trip_expense"."note"), 0) <= 200
        and "trip_expense"."amount_cents" between 1 and 100000000
        and "trip_expense"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'
        and "trip_expense"."version" >= 1
        and coalesce(char_length("trip_expense"."idempotency_key"), 0) <= 64

trip_info_time_check.name: trip_info_time_check
trip_info_time_check.value:
("trip_info"."check_in" is null or "trip_info"."check_in" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')
        and ("trip_info"."check_out" is null or "trip_info"."check_out" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')

trip_stay_length_check.name: trip_stay_length_check
trip_stay_length_check.value:
char_length("trip_stay"."url") <= 2048 and "trip_stay"."url" like 'https://%'
        and char_length("trip_stay"."title") between 1 and 80
        and coalesce(char_length("trip_stay"."note"), 0) <= 200
        and coalesce(char_length("trip_stay"."preview_site_name"), 0) <= 80

trip_stay_image_check.name: trip_stay_image_check
trip_stay_image_check.value:
"trip_stay"."preview_image_url" is null or (char_length("trip_stay"."preview_image_url") <= 2048
        and ("trip_stay"."preview_image_url" like 'https://%'
          or "trip_stay"."preview_image_url" ~ '^/demo/stays/[a-z0-9-]+[.]svg$'))

trip_stay_booked_check.name: trip_stay_booked_check
trip_stay_booked_check.value: "trip_stay"."booked_at" is null or "trip_stay"."chosen_at" is not null
